Detect hierarchical structure in data

Source: R/utils-hierarchy.R
detect_hierarchical_structure.Rd

Detect hierarchical structure in data

Usage

detect_hierarchical_structure(data, max_levels = 5, method = "auto")

Arguments

data

A data frame containing outcome and potential grouping variables.

max_levels

Integer specifying the maximum number of hierarchical levels to detect. Default is 5.

method

Character string specifying the detection method. One of "auto", "variance", or "information".

Value

A list with components levels, level_names, level_variables, n_levels, units_per_level, nesting_structure, cross_classification, recommendations, and icc_values.

Examples

d <- data.frame(
  case = rep(c("C1", "C2", "C3"), each = 8),
  phase = rep(c("A", "B"), 12),
  time = rep(1:8, 3),
  outcome = rnorm(24)
)
detect_hierarchical_structure(d)
